title: Dataset Onboarding Overview
summary: Overview of the dataset onboarding process within NDIT.
content: Dataset onboarding is the process of introducing a new dataset into NDIT. This includes discovery, governance assessment, onboarding approval, technical ingestion, testing and operational readiness.

title: Foundry Overview
content: Foundry provides capabilities for data ingestion, transformation, modelling, analytics and operational workflows. It is used to onboard, process and consume datasets across NDIT collections.

title: CRDL Overview
content: CRDL supports dataset discovery, onboarding, reference data management and controlled access to information assets.

title: MESH Integration Guide
content: MESH is used for secure movement of healthcare data. Typical implementation includes mailbox configuration, routing setup, testing and operational handover.

title: Data Sharing Agreements
content: A Data Sharing Agreement defines how information may be shared, who may access it and the responsibilities of the parties involved.

title: Data Protection Impact Assessments
content: A DPIA identifies privacy risks associated with processing personal information and records mitigation actions prior to implementation.

title: Virtual Wards Collection
summary: Overview of the Virtual Wards collection.
content: Virtual Wards contains datasets, reporting assets and integration services supporting remote care and virtual ward programmes.

title: Cancer Collection
content: The Cancer collection supports cancer services, reporting, analytics and operational data products across NDIT.

title: Population Health Collection
content: Population Health assets provide analytical and reporting capabilities across geographical and service-based populations.

title: Access Management Process
summary: Overview of access requests and approvals.
content: Access Management covers requesting access to services, datasets and platforms, obtaining approvals and managing permissions.
